cases.text: The last message I sent to claude should always be visible on the top of the CLI.
I want the 'wand section' with my favorite skills represented as emojis. I should be able to add, delete and modify those skills.
When the bedtime skill is running there should be a clear indication on the harness.
I want to modularize the tabs now, something like Adobe Photoshop tabs where I can resize them and attach them anywhere, so I can really set the layout as I want
We need to enhance the agents, add a few more states and also use a local model to make them display some dialogue bubbles with short, funny text according to whatever they are working on
wand skills should be triggered, not only written on the CLI.
we need an autonomous mode that reduces memory usage at maximum by also disabling most features of claude-custom, so I can let it run autonomously
include a section that displays CPU and memory usage per session, per project and in total.
the accent color of claude custom remains yellow despite changing it. It changes almost everywhere but in some places it remains yellow.
There should be a section that's completely personalized in real time by the instance that's running it, for example to save all the artifacts it creates or to display the time.
Map is kinda useless. I should be able to access the folders of the whole repo from there by clicking.
When a worktree is being used by an agent there should be something that signalizes it on the bar and on the window.
do agents work on other worktrees? if so, the worktree they are working on should be displayed in their cards.
we need to have a place where all the shortcuts are documented, inside the app but kinda hidden
a mark on a tab, chosen from about 10 emoji, so each one means something to me, like one for review this code
a field where I can input anything and a local model will index this information where it belongs in the documentation
host-identity's rename fails with EPERM on Windows sometimes, so the host can't publish its identity file
the N2 real-process Stop test still flakes when the full suite runs, it passes alone
the context circle's hover looks much more accurate than the token figure next to session in the header, one of them is wrong
after a reconnect the focus jumps out of the vault while I'm typing a secret
can project backgrounds be animated videos and not just GIFs?
I want to talk to Claude: voice to text into the input box
the indexing assistant is not slave mode, it's more like an indexing assistant, I'd use it mostly for adding ideas to the backlog
focus mode needs a button and a command too, not only a shortcut: hide all tabs so I see only the CLI
git tree rings: the rotation should be a sine wave, it goes forward and back slowly, never a full turn
wand buttons: a click should submit even mid-turn, the CLI's own queue takes the command
the resource panel's CPU warning should work even when the panel is closed
the permission-mode line under the input box should go too, check if a CLI setting hides it
for the live panel the running Claude builds: an artifact shelf with every artifact URL the session publishes, with title and time
the accent is still yellow on the agent count and the tool-belt glyphs on hover
the N2 real-process Stop test failed again in a full run on another branch, took 94 s
the bedtime sign on a tab should be a still deep blue, never animated, movement means needs you
agent speech bubbles: add a sleeping state with a snoring bubble
autonomous mode should also switch off the resource sampler, it costs CPU every 10 s
the file link hover says 'Opens X in its default app' because Electron has no API for the default app's name
Bash-mode ! commands trigger a model turn too, they aren't free
Bash heredocs collapse backslashes, write test files with Edit or Write instead
a squash merge breaks merged-finish's ancestry check, merge lane PRs with --merge
Run /merged ships type-only: it types /merged and I press Enter myself
Get-Process still lists an exited process while anyone holds a handle to it
Stryker makes no mutants inside template-literal text, so the PowerShell script bodies are outside the mutation score
one agent colour: blue #6aa5d8, defined once in agent-colour.css, never the accent
mutation runs are CPU-throttled unless bedtime: one run at a time on the machine, concurrency 2
Get-Process and CIM start times for the same process differ by one 100 ns tick, compare them with a tolerance
dock panels are hand-rolled on our own split tree, no docking library
a transcript line's cwd follows a cd in Bash, it's not the launching folder
